01 / the work

Things I’ve made (and shipped)

most of it is Minecraft’s fault.

featured · 2026 · founder & sole developer

VoxelPort

A free, open-source app that lets anyone host a Minecraft server from a PC or an Android phone, with no port forwarding. I made it because Jio and Airtel make port forwarding impossible. It’s an Electron desktop app, a Go relay running in India, an Android beta, a React website and a Discord bot with AI-assisted support tickets. Built with an AI coding assistant, and fully open source.

  • Electron
  • Go
  • React
  • TypeScript
  • Android
  • WebSockets
voxelport.in ↗ GitHub Microsoft Store Discord

where it all started →

Local Miner / LocalM

Minecraft hosting from your own PC without port forwarding or a VPN. It’s the project that pulled me into building things like this, and the reason VoxelPort exists. I worked on LocalM with the Local Miner team. Thank you, genuinely.

localm.eu.org ↗GitHub ↗

03 / the journey

Student, builder, team lead.

Hi, I’m Garv. I like taking a project from a blank file to something live: apps, relays, link pages, real-time widgets, 3D backgrounds, small tools. I study Game Design & AR/VR at Poornima University in Jaipur, I lead a team at AIESEC in India, and I’m building VoxelPort, a free tool that puts Minecraft servers online without port forwarding.

I work with code and with 3D, and I’m most useful where the two overlap.

Code
JavaScript · TypeScript · Java · Go · C++ · Node.js · React · Electron
Web & real-time
HTML & CSS · Vite · Three.js / WebGL · WebSockets
Ops
Linux · nginx · Git · GitHub Actions
Art
3D visualization · animation · UI & motion design
